findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 11 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 11.1 1, 11.2 5, 11.3 1, 11.4 1, 11.5 2, 11.6 3, 11.7 4, 11.8 4, 11.9 1, 11.10 2, 11.11 1.

25 four-mark theory parts (the chapter teaches no numericals) covering the classification of hydrocarbons, alkyl groups, IUPAC naming of alkanes and alkenes, shapes and physical properties of alkanes, bond fission, inertness of alkanes, halogenation and its free radical mechanism (with ethane as the new example), elimination, structure of ethene and the π bond, carbocations and inductive effects, addition reactions, Markovnikov's rule, polymerization, conjugated dienes, isomerism and organic redox. None repeats the exercise's descriptive questions. Book corrections followed: tert-butyl = 1,1-dimethylethyl, cyclopentane C₅H₁₀, Br⁻ as nucleophile, 2-bromoethanol + HBr, metamers ethoxyethane/methoxypropane, balanced ethane combustion.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
